blocks.body:
Hello Luis,

Thanks for your request. Attached is quote VQ-2026-0413 for the stainless enclosures, back panels, vent kits and Z-brackets. The subtotal is $5,199.00, before freight.

A few points to confirm before we finalize:

- Z-brackets: we quoted 200 at our 100+ price. Please confirm the exact quantity.
- Rain hoods: stainless rain hoods are not on our standard price list. We are checking options and will come back to you separately.
- Back panels: the standard panels for this size are galvanized steel. Let us know if you need a different material for the washdown areas.
- Freight: please send the delivery address so we can add freight.

The quote is valid until Dec 18, 2026, on Net 30 terms.

Best regards,
Vantrell Manufacturing Sales
